basic_info.description: Welcome to 188-190 Guerrero Street, a well-maintained triplex in the heart of Mission Dolores, one of San Francisco's most vibrant and sought-after neighborhoods. This exceptional property offers a prime opportunity for both owner-occupants and investors, with two units delivered vacant and ready for immediate occupancy or leasing at market rates. The building features classic San Francisco charm with hardwood floors, high ceilings, bay windows, and abundant natural light. Each unit includes in-unit laundry for modern convenience. Recent updates enhance the property's aesthetics and functionality while preserving its historic character. A shared backyard offers a peaceful outdoor retreat. Ideally located near Whole Foods, Church Street Metro, Dolores Park, and Valencia Street's top restaurants and cafes, with easy access to 16th & Mission BART and Highway 101. Whether seeking a primary residence or a high-demand investment, this triplex offers significant upside potential in an unbeatable location.
